title: AI for Local SEO & Google Business Profile Optimisation - LocalHQ

facts.fact: LocalHQ offers a 7-day free trial of its AI Assistant for local SEO, started by signing up with Google.
LocalHQ claims its AI Assistant makes Google Business Listing optimisation 25x faster (vendor's own claim, not independently verified).
facts.quote: 25x Faster optimisation of your Google Business Listing.
